requirements.contract: Explicit native Metal device selection and availability; CPU tensors remain CPU unless explicitly transferred. Unavailable Metal requests are visible and never silently execute on CPU.
requirements.scenario: Request Metal explicitly and verify availability/device selection; request it when unavailable and require a visible error, with the input tensor remaining on CPU.

requirements.contract: Inventory pinned MPS dtype mappings separately from per-operation support. Float32 is the baseline; cover float16/bfloat16, signed/unsigned integers, bool and mapped complex types individually. Float64 tensor requests must be explicitly rejected, not silently cast or run on CPU.
requirements.scenario: For each mapped dtype run an operation-specific representability probe and compare dtype/device; float64 creation on Metal must report unsupported without CPU fallback or cast.

requirements.contract: CPU↔Metal round-trip for [1,2,3,4,5,6]; transpose and offset-slice preserve logical values and aliasing. Track materialization explicitly; contiguous copies cannot claim alias semantics.
requirements.scenario: In float32 transfer [[1,2,3],[4,5,6]], mutate transpose view at [0,1] to 9, and verify base/view values; also check offset slice and report whether each operation aliases or materializes.

requirements.contract: Float32 versions of both broadcast cases and 2-D matmul; preserve shape, numel, dtype and native device. Include scalar/empty metadata. CPU float64 fixtures do not satisfy this requirement.
requirements.scenario: Run the parity broadcast inputs [[0],[10]] + [[0,1,2]], [[0,1,2],[3,4,5]] + [10,20,30], and [[1,2],[3,4]] @ [[5,6],[7,8]] as float32 Metal operations; verify results, metadata and device.

requirements.contract: Native Metal mean and mean-MSE forward/backward; graph values and gradients stay on Metal. Unsupported operations are reported, not replaced by CPU gradients.
requirements.scenario: Run float32 mean on [[1,2],[3,4]] and mean-MSE on [[1,2,3],[4,5,6]] against zero target; check gradients and device placement for outputs and gradients.

requirements.contract: Native Metal forward→mean-MSE→backward→SGD with prediction 11, loss 121, gradients [66,88], updated weights [0.34,1.12]. Track gradient-reset semantics separately; optimizer step does not imply zero_grad.
requirements.scenario: Use weights [1,2], input [3,4], scalar target 0 and learning rate 0.01; verify every intermediate and device placement, and separately test explicit gradient reset.

requirements.contract: Dependent queued kernels complete in order; synchronize before host reads. Buffers survive queued work and metadata aliases. Inventory synchronization, events and stream APIs separately from a single global queue.
requirements.scenario: Enqueue dependent writes/reads with retained buffers and aliases, synchronize, and assert order and host-visible final value; independently exercise event and current/set/default stream behavior.

requirements.contract: Distinguish active tensor bytes, driver/cache allocation and recommended limits; cover allocation/release/cache and invalid memory fractions. Driver/cache bytes need not equal live tensor bytes. Placement requires GPU/copy/fallback evidence, not availability alone.
requirements.scenario: Measure live tensor allocation, release references, clear cache and remeasure; compare driver and recommended limits without assuming equality; exercise invalid fractions and capture an operation trace that establishes GPU execution or fallback.

requirements.contract: A native Metal generator supports seed, state save/restore and identical redraw on that backend; CPU/GPU bitwise RNG equivalence is not assumed.
requirements.scenario: Seed Metal RNG, save state, draw a fixed tensor, restore the saved state, redraw and require exact same-backend equality and Metal placement.

requirements.contract: Inventory shader compile and metallib load; execute a native vector-doubling kernel [1,2,3,4]→[2,4,6,8] with device execution/completion evidence and visible errors.
requirements.scenario: Compile a shader and load a metallib through native APIs; dispatch vector doubling, await completion, verify values and device trace, then verify malformed source/library reports its error.

requirements.contract: Load .aimodel/.aimodelc, inspect function names/descriptors, distinguish missing function from load error, then infer. Identity float32 [1.25,-2] returns unchanged.
requirements.scenario: Load a named identity model function, inspect names and descriptor, run float32 [1.25,-2] and compare exact output; separately report absent function and invalid model failures.

requirements.contract: Honor strict descriptor dtype/shape/rank. Float32 [2] identity accepts [1.25,-2]; wrong dtype or shape is explicitly rejected. Scalar type enumeration does not prove model support for all types.
requirements.scenario: Invoke a float32 shape-[2] identity with valid values, then wrong dtype and wrong shape, requiring explicit descriptor errors without silent conversion.

requirements.contract: Identity preserves logical [[1,2,3],[4,5,6]] for contiguous input and storage [99,1,4,2,5,3,6,99], shape [2,3], element strides [1,2], one-element offset. Resolve dynamic dimensions before stride/minimum-byte queries; returned allocated arrays are row-major contiguous.
requirements.scenario: Run identity inference on contiguous and offset strided views, compare logical values, query preferred stride/minimum bytes only after dimensions resolve, and inspect returned allocated layout.

requirements.contract: Borrow strided float32 layout from .shared MTLBuffer with byte offset 4; preserve guard values 99. Retain owner/view and exclude competing writes during inference. Unsupported storage/layout is visible; zero-copy requires copy/buffer evidence.
requirements.scenario: Create shared buffer for [99,1,4,2,5,3,6,99], borrow shape [2,3] with strides [1,2] and offset 4, infer, then verify both guards and alias/copy evidence while owners remain alive.

requirements.contract: Encode producer→inference→consumer on ComputeStream(commandQueue:), await currentWorkCompleted() before host access/reuse. Buffer and function outlive pending work; waiting one stream does not certify unrelated queues.
requirements.scenario: On one command queue enqueue producer, inference and consumer; await that stream, validate output and then release owners; show another independent queue is outside the awaited completion scope.

requirements.contract: Declared scalar state increments 0→1→2 across calls using same mutable state view; missing state errors. Preallocated output views update in place and do not also appear in returned outputs.
requirements.scenario: Call stateful function twice with shared state view and verify values 1 then 2; omit required state and require error; supply preallocated output, verify mutation and exclusion from returned outputs.

sources.symbol: InferenceFunction; caller-provided state and output views

requirements.contract: Independent identity calls [1,2] and [3,4] through one loaded function produce isolated outputs. Function-owned weights/intermediates and caller-owned mutable state are distinct; never unsafely share mutable state buffers.
requirements.scenario: Invoke one loaded identity function concurrently on independent input/output buffers and verify each output; separately confirm stateful calls use distinct state buffers or explicit synchronization.

requirements.contract: Record available units and .default/.cpuOnly/GPU-preferred/Neural-Engine-preferred policies. CPU-only Core AI correctness is Core AI coverage, not Metal/ANE. Preferences may fall back; unobserved placement is unverified.
requirements.scenario: Run identity under each policy, log allowed/preferred units and independently collect actual placement evidence; only explicitly observed placement earns hardware-specific coverage.
